body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-19 15:08Z, a miss I made twice today and caught both times before launch: S1 at 09:39Z, M4 at 15:07Z). Before any gate GO, compare the candidate's base with the CURRENT origin/master. If master has moved, the candidate must carry onto the new master and refreeze BEFORE the gate, because a gate on the old base gates a tree that will never be committed. A disjoint carry keeps the review pair (rev3); an overlapping one needs a confirmation pair. Check with `git rev-parse origin/master` against the READY's stated base at every gate GO.
